metadata.name: BsnModule
metadata.title: BSN PowerShell module scaffold
metadata.description: Scaffolds a new Bsn.* PowerShell module inside the Lmt.Commons repository, including the module manifest, public/private command structure, an about_ help topic and Pester tests.
metadata.author: BSVN

parameter.name: ModuleName
parameter.prompt: Enter the module name (must start with 'Bsn.'):

parameter.name: CmdletName
parameter.prompt: Enter the name of the first public command (approved Verb-Noun):

content.message:
Scaffolding your BSN module. Plaster is about to create the following structure:
src/ModuleName/ModuleName.psd1 src/ModuleName/ModuleName.psm1 src/ModuleName/Public/CmdletName.ps1 src/ModuleName/Private/ (helper functions) src/ModuleName/en-US/about_ModuleName.help.txt src/ModuleName/tests/ (Pester tests)

Your new module has been created!
Next steps: 1. Implement the command in Public/ and helpers in Private/. 2. Adjust the Pester tests under tests/. 3. Run ./build.ps1 -Task Analyze, Test 4. Bump the module version and push a v* tag to publish to the PowerShell Gallery.
